subject.title: fix(sessions): preserve parent lifecycle for parallel children

question: Should `sessions.create.succeedsParent` remain the supported public contract for distinguishing a successor from a parallel parent-linked child, with omission preserving legacy rollover behavior?
rationale: This is a new gateway and SDK-facing lifecycle API whose semantics affect plugins and external clients; the code can preserve compatibility, but maintainers must choose the durable contract shape.

options.title: Adopt the explicit disposition
options.body: Keep the optional boolean and legacy omission semantics, after adding the missing Control UI old-gateway fallback.

options.title: Choose a different public lifecycle API
options.body: Specify an enum or another contract before merging, then update all clients and protocol documentation consistently.

recommendation.title: Adopt the explicit disposition
recommendation.body: Keep the optional boolean and legacy omission semantics, after adding the missing Control UI old-gateway fallback.
